scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared-lib && npm run build --workspace=simply-tweeted-app
scripts.check: npm run build --workspace=shared-lib && npm run check --workspace=simply-tweeted-app && npm run check --workspace=tweet-poster-service
scripts.secrets:push: wrangler secret bulk secrets.json --config packages/simply-tweeted-app/wrangler.jsonc && jq '{DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY,AUTH_TWITTER_ID,AUTH_TWITTER_SECRET}' secrets.json | wrangler secret bulk --config packages/scheduler/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run build --workspace=shared-lib && npm run deploy --workspace=simply-tweeted-app && npm run deploy --workspace=tweet-poster-service
